note: Ordinary bread is the thing the figure is drawn from: "you ate the loaves and had your fill" (John 6:26) opens the bread-of-life discourse, and "tell these stones to become bread" (Matt 4:3) is answered with "Man shall not live on bread alone" (4:4).
Jesus: "I am the bread of life" (6:35, 6:48); "I am the living bread that came down from heaven" (6:51). Stated outright by the one it names; says nothing of the Last Supper (readers differ).
"They devour my people like bread" - God's people likened to bread eaten by the workers of iniquity. Ground: consumed without a thought.
"for they will be like bread for us" - Joshua and Caleb of the people of the land: easily taken.
"I saw a loaf of barley bread come tumbling into the Midianite camp" - the dream is built on the loaf; the key (the sword of Gideon) is in 7:14.
